PT Taka Hydrocore Indonesia carried out a Corporate Social Responsibility activity on 27 May 2026 as part of its commitment to supporting local communities and creating a positive social impact.

The activity involved the slaughtering of sacrificial animals and the distribution of qurban meat to families living in RT 01/02 RW 06, Cisaranten Kidul, Gedebage District, Bandung City. The program was held in celebration of Eid al-Adha 1447 H and aimed to share happiness and blessings with the surrounding community. 

PT Taka Hydrocore Indonesia was represented by Mr. Syamsul Adi during the activity. He expressed his appreciation for the positive response from local residents and stated that seeing their happiness provided further motivation for the company to continue contributing to the community. 

Through this initiative, PT Taka Hydrocore Indonesia seeks to strengthen its relationship with the local community while respecting local values, traditions, and culture.

The activity also reflects the company’s ongoing commitment to implementing sustainable social responsibility and creating meaningful benefits for the communities around its operations.
items.summary: As part of its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) commitment, PT Taka Hydrocore Indonesia organized the slaughtering and distribution of sacrificial meat to residents of Cisaranten Kidul, Bandung, in celebration of Eid al-Adha 1447 H.
items.title: PT Taka Hydrocore Indonesia Shares Eid al-Adha Sacrificial Meat with the Cisaranten Kidul Community

items.body:
On August 6, 2026, Taka Hydrocore Indonesia (THI) had the pleasure of welcoming Geophysics students from Universitas Padjadjaran (UNPAD) as part of a Company Visit program. The visit provided an opportunity for students to gain exposure to the industrial environment while learning about the practical application of geophysical knowledge in a professional workplace.

The program began with a welcome address from the Taka Hydrocore Indonesia team, marking the official opening of the visit. The event continued with an Office Tour, giving students the opportunity to explore THI’s working environment and gain a closer look at the company’s activities and operations.

The students then participated in a knowledge-sharing session about Taka Hydrocore Indonesia, with a particular focus on THI’s expertise in **Geotechnical and Geophysical Survey services**. During the session, students were introduced to the company’s profile, services, and an overview of how geotechnical and geophysical surveys are applied to support industry needs.

The session also provided an opportunity for students to understand the connection between knowledge gained through their academic studies and its practical application in the professional world.

The visit was conducted in an interactive and engaging atmosphere, featuring discussions and knowledge exchange between the UNPAD students and the THI team. Through this activity, THI aimed to provide students with broader perspectives on the professional working environment, competencies required in the industry, and potential career opportunities in the geoscience and surveying fields.

The event concluded with the presentation of a commemorative plaque, symbolizing appreciation and the positive relationship established between UNPAD and THI, followed by a group photo to capture the memorable moment of the Company Visit.

Through this initiative, Taka Hydrocore Indonesia continues to support collaboration between the academic and industrial sectors while contributing to the development of competent young talents who are prepared to face the challenges of the professional world.

**Connecting Knowledge, Industry, and Future Talent.**

Taka Hydrocore Indonesia (THI), through **AG Geodrill**, has successfully completed offshore geotechnical survey activities at **West Belut-H04, Natuna Offshore**, as part of the **Provision of Geotechnical Survey Services for South Natuna Sea Block B** for **Medco E&P Natuna Ltd.**

The project was carried out to support offshore operations by providing essential geotechnical information required to better understand seabed and subsurface conditions at the project location.

As part of the overall geotechnical survey scope, the services included **Soil Sampling / Geotechnical Borehole, Piezocone Penetration Test (PCPT), Pilot Hole Drilling, Laboratory Testing, as well as Data Processing, Analysis, and Reporting**.

The geotechnical borehole and PCPT activities were designed to support **jack-up leg spud can penetration and punch-through analysis**, providing important information for evaluating soil conditions and supporting safe offshore operations.

Throughout the offshore campaign, AG Geodrill served as the dedicated soil investigation vessel, supporting survey activities with the required equipment, personnel, and operational capabilities.

The completion of the West Belut-H04 activities represents another milestone for Taka Hydrocore Indonesia in delivering integrated offshore geotechnical survey services. Through reliable field operations, technical expertise, and a strong commitment to safety and quality, THI continues to support clients in obtaining critical subsurface information for offshore engineering and operational decision-making.

This achievement also reflects the dedication and collaboration of the project team, vessel crew, technical personnel, and supporting teams involved throughout the operation.

**Delivering reliable geotechnical insight for confident offshore decisions.**
items.summary: Taka Hydrocore Indonesia, through AG Geodrill, has completed offshore geotechnical survey activities at West Belut-H04 in the South Natuna Sea Block B, supporting Medco E&P Natuna Ltd. with critical subsurface data for offshore operations.
